title: curie skill message --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie skill message` under `--json`: the full buffered model reply, final ACI session status, and approval metadata from the final frame (the human path streams tokens live and never builds this).

finalized.description: Whether the turn is terminal. This is false for an awaiting-approval park, which can resume after an approval decision, and true for every other final-frame status.

approval_summary.description: The runner-provided human-readable approval request summary, or null when the final frame carries no approval request.

approval_route.description: The runner-provided approval route name, or null when no route applies.

approval_gate_kind.description: The runner-provided kind of approval gate that parked or governed the turn, or null when no gate applies.

approval_granted_tool.description: The runner-provided tool name associated with a granted approval, or null when no tool grant applies.
